description.en: Mrs Birkett's viewing station on its rock above the lake: the island in the lake, a pike among the fells, a buzzard circling, the haze of summer, the church bell far below, the visitors' book and its stamp, and Old Wilf's rests on the way up.
description.sl: Razgledna hišica gospe Birkett na skali nad jezerom: otok v jezeru, koničasti vrh med hribi, kanja, ki kroži, poletna sopara, cerkveni zvon daleč spodaj, knjiga vtisov in njen žig ter počitki starega Wilfa na poti gor.
description.it: Il belvedere della signora Birkett sulla roccia sopra il lago: l'isola nel lago, un picco tra i monti, una poiana che gira in cerchio, la caligine d'estate, la campana della chiesa laggiù, il libro dei visitatori col suo timbro e le soste del vecchio Wilf lungo la salita.
description.de: Frau Birketts Aussichtshäuschen auf dem Felsen über dem See: die Insel im See, eine Bergspitze zwischen den Bergen, ein Bussard, der kreist, der Dunst im Sommer, die Kirchenglocke tief unten, das Gästebuch und sein Stempel und die Pausen des alten Wilf auf dem Weg hinauf.

words.example_en: The viewing station stands on a rock above the lake.
words.example_sl: Razgledna hišica stoji na skali nad jezerom.
words.example_it: Il belvedere sta su una roccia sopra il lago.
words.example_de: Das Aussichtshäuschen steht auf einem Felsen über dem See.
words.note: In 1778 Thomas West's guide to the Lakes sent the first tourists to viewing stations like this.
words.note_sl: Leta 1778 je vodnik Thomasa Westa po Lake Districtu poslal prve turiste na takšne razgledne točke.
words.note_it: Nel 1778 la guida del Lake District di Thomas West mandò i primi turisti in belvedere come questo.
words.note_de: 1778 schickte Thomas Wests Führer durch den Lake District die ersten Touristen zu solchen Aussichtspunkten.

words.example_en: That pike over there is Harrison Stickle.
words.example_sl: Tisti koničasti vrh tam je Harrison Stickle.
words.example_it: Quel picco laggiù è l'Harrison Stickle.
words.example_de: Die Bergspitze dort drüben ist der Harrison Stickle.
words.note: In the Lakes a pike is a fell with a pointed top: Scafell Pike, the Langdale Pikes. A pike is a fish too!
words.note_sl: V Lake Districtu je pike hrib s koničastim vrhom: Scafell Pike, Langdale Pikes. Pike je tudi ščuka!
words.note_it: Nel Lake District un pike è un monte con la cima a punta: Scafell Pike, i Langdale Pikes. Pike è anche il luccio!
words.note_de: Im Lake District ist ein pike ein Berg mit spitzem Gipfel: Scafell Pike, die Langdale Pikes. Pike ist auch der Hecht!

words.example_en: Please write your name in the visitors' book.
words.example_sl: Prosim, vpišite se v knjigo vtisov.
words.example_it: Per favore, scriva il suo nome nel libro dei visitatori.
words.example_de: Bitte tragen Sie sich ins Gästebuch ein.
words.note: The apostrophe comes after the s: the book of many visitors.
words.note_sl: Opuščaj je za s: knjiga mnogih obiskovalcev.
words.note_it: L'apostrofo va dopo la s: il libro di tanti visitatori.
words.note_de: Der Apostroph steht nach dem s: das Buch vieler Besucher.

words.example_en: Put the stamp in your book, next to your name.
words.example_sl: Daj žig v svojo knjižico, zraven svojega imena.
words.example_it: Metti il timbro nel tuo libretto, accanto al tuo nome.
words.example_de: Mach den Stempel in dein Heft, neben deinen Namen.
words.note: A stamp is also the little picture on a letter: a postage stamp.
words.note_sl: Stamp je tudi znamka na pismu: a postage stamp.
words.note_it: Stamp è anche il francobollo sulla lettera: a postage stamp.
words.note_de: Stamp ist auch die Briefmarke: a postage stamp.

words.example_en: A buzzard is circling over the dale.
words.example_it: Una poiana gira in cerchio sopra la valle.
words.example_de: Ein Bussard kreist über dem Tal.
words.note: The commonest bird of prey in Britain. It calls like a cat: pee-yow!
words.note_sl: Najpogostejša ujeda v Britaniji. Kliče kot mačka: pi-jau!
words.note_it: Il rapace più comune in Gran Bretagna. Chiama come un gatto: pii-au!
words.note_de: Der häufigste Greifvogel Großbritanniens. Er ruft wie eine Katze: hiäh!

words.example_en: In summer there's a haze over the far fells.
words.example_sl: Poleti je nad daljnimi hribi sopara.
words.example_it: D'estate c'è la caligine sui monti lontani.
words.example_de: Im Sommer liegt Dunst über den fernen Bergen.
words.note: A haze is thin, dry and warm; a mist is wet. It's hazy: there's a haze.
words.note_sl: Haze je redka, suha in topla; mist je vlažna. It's hazy: soparno je.
words.note_it: Haze è leggera, secca e calda; mist è umida. It's hazy: c'è caligine.
words.note_de: Haze ist dünn, trocken und warm; mist ist feucht. It's hazy: es ist dunstig.

words.example_en: There's a wooded island in the lake.
words.example_it: Nel lago c'è un'isola coperta di boschi.
words.example_de: Im See liegt eine bewaldete Insel.
words.note: The s in island is silent: say EYE-land.
words.note_sl: S v island se ne izgovori: »ajlend«.
words.note_it: La s di island non si pronuncia: «àiland».
words.note_de: Das s in island spricht man nicht: »ailänd«.

words.example_en: Let's have a rest on this step.
words.example_sl: Malo se spočijva na tej stopnici.
words.example_it: Riposiamoci un po' su questo gradino.
words.example_de: Machen wir eine Pause auf dieser Stufe.
words.note: Have a rest, take a rest: stop for a bit and sit down.
words.note_sl: Have a rest, take a rest: malo se ustavi in sedi.
words.note_it: Have a rest, take a rest: fermati un po' e siediti.
words.note_de: Have a rest, take a rest: kurz anhalten und sich setzen.

words.example_en: The sea is far away, behind the fells.
words.example_it: Il mare è lontano, dietro i monti.
words.example_de: Das Meer ist weit weg, hinter den Bergen.
words.note: Far, further, the furthest. How far is it? Is it far?
words.note_sl: Far, further, the furthest. How far is it? Je daleč?
words.note_it: Far, further, the furthest. How far is it? È lontano?
words.note_de: Far, further, the furthest. How far is it? Ist es weit?

words.example_en: The village is far below us.
words.example_sl: Vas je daleč spodaj pod nami.
words.example_it: Il paese è giù in basso, sotto di noi.
words.example_de: Das Dorf liegt tief unten unter uns.
words.note: Below is under, lower down: the lake below the station.
words.note_sl: Below je pod, nižje spodaj: the lake below the station.
words.note_it: Below è sotto, più in basso: the lake below the station.
words.note_de: Below ist unter, weiter unten: the lake below the station.

words.example_en: We can hear the church bell from up here.
words.example_sl: Od tu gor slišimo cerkveni zvon.
words.example_it: Da quassù sentiamo la campana della chiesa.
words.example_de: Von hier oben hören wir die Kirchenglocke.
words.note: The bell rings, it rang, it has rung.
words.note_sl: The bell rings (zvon zvoni), it rang, it has rung.
words.note_it: The bell rings (la campana suona), it rang, it has rung.
words.note_de: The bell rings (die Glocke läutet), it rang, it has rung.
